name: cxr_classification_tool
description: Classify chest X-ray images with open-source TorchXRayVision pathology classifiers and return model-derived pathology probabilities.

runtime.notes: Single-image inference can run on CPU, but CUDA is preferred when available. Supports TorchXRayVision DenseNet121 224px presets and the ResNet50 512px all-data preset. Weights must be available in the configured cache directory or downloadable in the runtime environment.

help.summary: Runs a selected TorchXRayVision chest X-ray pathology classifier on the active CXR image or DICOM source.

options.name: model_weights
options.description: TorchXRayVision pretrained weight set. Supported: densenet121-res224-all, densenet121-res224-rsna, densenet121-res224-nih, densenet121-res224-pc, densenet121-res224-chex, densenet121-res224-mimic_nb, densenet121-res224-mimic_ch, resnet50-res512-all. Short aliases: all, rsna, nih, pc, chex, mimic_nb, mimic_ch, resnet.

options.name: threshold
options.description: Probability cutoff used for positive flagging in the Studio result.

options.name: device
options.description: Use auto, cpu, cuda, or cuda:<index>.

notes: Use only on chest radiographs, not CT/MRI/NIfTI or non-CXR images.
The output is model-derived screening support and is not a final clinical diagnosis.
